goldens.comment: The @loaded_locales instance variable in translate_accelerator.rb is lazily initialized and accessed by multiple concurrent threads without synchronization.
goldens.reasoning: No candidate raises thread-safety or synchronization of @loaded_locales.

goldens.comment: Consider normalizing the input locale (e.g., to a symbol) when checking/loading here to avoid double-loading if the same locale is passed as a String vs Symbol (also applies to other locations in the PR).
goldens.reasoning: No candidate mentions normalizing String vs Symbol locales to avoid loading the same locale twice.

candidates: Background-job contexts (e.g. app/jobs/base.rb sets I18n.locale = SiteSetting.default_locale) can hit missing translations when the backend falls back to :en/site default locales that haven't been loaded by the translate accelerator yet - the 'ensure fallbacks locales are loaded' behavior should be moved to a shared entry point for jobs/mailers

No specs assert that server-side fallbacks actually resolve (e.g. missing key in user locale falls back to site default and then :en) - adding a focused spec would help prevent regressions in fallback ordering/loading
